title: Transaction and component recovery need scoped drills and protected inputs
remediation: Deployment recovery operators and component maintainers identify transaction-based stores, critical components and protected recovery tools. Exercise rollback or journal recovery on each applicable transaction store and restore components from approved integrity-checked baselines. Measure time to known operational state, verify protection and access limits on recovery components, and record sponsor decisions for inapplicable objectives.

milestones.title: Capture applicable transaction repair, timed reconstitution from known baselines, and reviewed recovery tool access
Verify relay recovery from its approved operator runbook when it is in scope
